title: Residual Boils
summary: Residual Boils is an Arcane Enhancement for Kitguns that grants them the ability to create hives of  Heat on kill.
extract:
Residual Boils is an Arcane Enhancement for Kitguns that grants them the ability to create hives of  Heat on kill.
Can be sold for  1,000.

Effect

Acquisition
Residual Boils can be acquired from Rotation A of Isolation Vault Bounties (normal and Arcana).

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Explosions have a radial falloff of ~90%
Explosions have a 20% chance to proc  Heat status.
Residual Arcanes can only have two active puddles at a time. For example; creating two puddles with a primary kitgun will prevent both your primary and secondary kitgun from creating any until the first two expire.
Will deal heat explosions that do not add or combine with weapon elemental effects, retaining heat damage on explosions.

Trivia
The Orokin Writing on the Residual Boils' image roughly translates to "Lesions", an inconsistency shared with  Residual Malodor. It is possible that Lesions was an earlier name of the Enhancement used during development.
